title: docs(spec): describe innerRefusal as a node's read, write or script function-resolution refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XWxQLsgSQRnPoMBK1Pyo8Ya)_

Fixes #33402

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`innerRefusal` 的说明文字（`AutomationResult.innerRefusal` 与 `FlowFailureDetailsSchema.innerRefusal` 的 describe、`FlowInnerRefusalSchema` 与 `FlowFailureDetailsSchema` 的 JSDoc、`contracts/automation-service.ts` 的 JSDoc）从「节点写入时遇到的拒绝」改为「节点在运行中遇到的拒绝（数据节点的读或写，或 `script` 节点解析函数名）」；生成的 API 参考随之更新。
- 为什么改：运行时四个数据节点（含读取的 `get_record`）和 `script` 节点函数名解析失败（`RESOURCE_CONFLICT`，ADR-0150 D3）都会填这个字段；旧说法让写流程错误处理的客户端和 AI 以为读取或函数名拒绝不会出现在这里。
- 风险与回滚：只改说明文字，schema 形状、枚举、可选性、导出和类型都不变，同一输入解析结果不变；spec patch changeset。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts` 的两处 `innerRefusal` describe；其次 `content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx` 的两行生成结果。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n -i "write met inside" -- packages/spec/src content/docs/references`，预期零命中（main 上 7 处）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Wording only. The text now says what the producers on `main` do: `refusalCarriedBy` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/inner-refusal.ts`) is spread into all four data-node catch arms of `builtin/crud-nodes.ts` (`get_record`'s arm included, so a READ refusal lands in `innerRefusal`), and into the `script` node's function-resolution refusal in `builtin/screen-nodes.ts` (a `config.function` that names no single function for the flow's package, `code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`, ADR-0150 D3, PR #32257).

- `packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts`
  - `FlowInnerRefusalSchema` JSDoc, first sentence: FROM "The refusal a flow node's write met INSIDE the run — the structured answer the data layer gave the node, …" TO "The refusal a flow node met INSIDE the run (a data node's read or write, or a `script` node's function resolution) — the structured answer the data layer (or the function resolver) gave the node, …". The "(or the function resolver)" clause is added because "the data layer" alone would be false for the `script` node's refusal; the rest of the sentence is unchanged.
  - `AutomationResult.innerRefusal` (`TriggerFlowResponseSchema`) `.describe`: FROM "The refusal a node's write met inside the run, structured: …" TO "The refusal a node met inside the run (a data node's read or write, or a `script` node's function resolution), structured: …". The rest is byte-identical.
  - `FlowFailureDetailsSchema` JSDoc: FROM "the refusal a node's write met inside the run, as `innerRefusal`" TO "the refusal a node met inside the run (a data node's read or write, or a `script` node's function resolution), as `innerRefusal`".
  - `FlowFailureDetailsSchema.innerRefusal` `.describe`: FROM "The refusal a node's write met inside the run (`AutomationResult.innerRefusal`): …" TO "The refusal a node met inside the run (a data node's read or write, or a `script` node's function resolution; `AutomationResult.innerRefusal`): …".
  - `userMessage`'s describe already says "the refusal a node met inside the run": left as it is.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`, `AutomationResult.innerRefusal` JSDoc: same change as above (the card did not list this site; the order added it).
- `content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx`: regenerated with `cd packages/spec && pnpm gen:schema && pnpm gen:docs` (not hand-edited). Only the two `innerRefusal` rows move (the `FlowFailureDetails` and `AutomationResult` tables). No other generated file changed.
- `.changeset/33402-inner-refusal-describe.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`. The describe text ships in spec `dist` and the JSDoc in its declarations.

No schema shape, enum, optional/required, export or type changes.

## Tests

- No behaviour changes, so no test is added and nothing is ablated. No test or snapshot pins the old sentence: on `origin/main` `f068cde8`, `git grep -n "write met"` over `packages/spec`, `content/docs` and `skills` hit only the five edited source sites and the two generated rows.
- After the edit, `git grep -n "write met" -- packages/spec content/docs skills` shows zero hits that describe `innerRefusal` (the remaining hits are "write metadata …" sentences and released `CHANGELOG.md` entries about other subjects).
- On `4da1fb68`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/api/automation-api src/contracts/automation-service`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 93 passed (93) (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

## Acceptance notes

Comments in `packages/services/**` are outside this card's surface. Two still describe the inner refusal as the data nodes' alone; reported, not touched:

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:416-420` (`NodeExecutionResult.innerRefusal` doc): "The refusal this node's data call met … Set by the CRUD executors' catch arms". The `script` node's function-resolution refusal sets it too.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/inner-refusal.ts:54-56` (`refusalCarriedBy` doc): "the one call each data node's catch arm makes (`builtin/crud-nodes.ts`), so the four arms cannot drift …", and `:64` "the caller asked for a write the platform will not do". `builtin/screen-nodes.ts` also calls it.
- `FlowInnerRefusalSchema.code`'s describe ("the ADR-0112 member a record save of the same write answers in `error.code`") and the contract JSDoc's "the shape a record save of the same write answers with" keep their wording: they name the comparison for the code spelling, not which node met the refusal, and the order keeps each sentence's other clauses as they are.

## Verification

On `4da1fb68` (after building the spec, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/objectql`, client and client-react closures): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 103 commands, run one by one with `timeout 900`, each exit code captured before any pipe.

- 101 exited 0 in the loop, among them `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` (the regenerated reference is current), `check:docs`, `check:skill-examples` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 in the loop (shallow clone: its pinned fixture commit was absent). After `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` it exited 0 ("48 cases pass").
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`; only the closures above were built), so it is NOT MEASURED here and left to CI.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "103 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 102 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- Local-only `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` exited 1 because 91 of 107 workspace packages have no `dist` (only the closures above were built); it judges this checkout's build state, not the diff, so it is NOT MEASURED for this change.
- Spec drift gate (order hypothesis): yes. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs` (also run inside `check:generated`, whose roster maps it to `gen:docs` and `content/docs/references/**`) reds a reference that no longer matches the `.describe` text; `cd packages/spec && pnpm gen:schema && pnpm gen:docs` regenerates it. Both exited 0 on this head.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No name added.)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run, not run locally.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (Left to the seat's review.)
